name: django-react
description: Django + DRF + Celery con frontend React (CRA) y docker-compose (Sentri).

gateCommands.G1: ruff check backend && npm --prefix frontend run build
gateCommands.G2: cd backend && python -m pytest && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend test
gateCommands.G6: gitleaks git --no-banner --redact -v . && bandit -q -r backend -c backend/pyproject.toml && pip-audit -r backend/requirements.txt && osv-scanner scan source -r .
